'''Tsun Qel''' was a member of the [[Shaper caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. A [[Initiate (Shaper)|Shaper Initiate]] of [[Domain Qel]], he went to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], to look in on the [[Shaping protocol|shaping]] of [[Tahiri Veila]]. He told [[Shaper Adept]] [[Nen Yim]] that he had been sent by [[Mezhan Kwaad]] herself, and made mention of [[Yakun Kwaad]], a former shaper apprentice and Nen's dead lover, as evidence. Convinced, she told Qel of everything that Kwaad and Yim had performed. In truth, however, Tsun Qel had been sent by [[Master Shaper]] [[Yal Phaath]] to investigate whether or not they had performed heresy.<ref name="Conquest" />
